speaker: rich
transcript: Cat Eye Eight-One, this is Rich. Your relay information worked. A Gravitas unit reached my location and delivered an antigen pack. The drop was real. The instructions say early-stage infection only, but they don’t tell me what early stage actually looks like. I have someone nearby who can still walk, still find familiar places, maybe even recognize a voice. I need to know what signs mean there’s still time, and what happens if the dose is given too late. I want to use this to help people, not just lock it away. What have you heard that you trust? Over.
summary: Rich confirms the Gravitas delivery and asks CatEye81 for trustworthy information about the antigen treatment window.
defaultEmotion: grateful, technical, guarded, and urgently hopeful
